description: This file defines the 'Trends' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing statistical trend analysis functions such as correlation, covariance, forecasting, and growth calculations. It includes methods to perform linear and exponential trend computations, regressions, and related statistical metrics.

classes.name: Trends
classes.description: Provides statistical trend analysis methods for data series, including correlation, covariance, forecasting, and regression analysis within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: CORREL
methods.description: Calculates the correlation coefficient between two data series, returning a measure of linear dependence.

methods.name: COVAR
methods.description: Calculates the covariance between two data series, indicating how two variables vary together.

methods.name: FORECAST
methods.description: Predicts a future value based on existing data using linear trend analysis for a specified x-value.

methods.name: GROWTH
methods.description: Calculates exponential growth values along a predicted exponential trend for given data points.

methods.name: INTERCEPT
methods.description: Calculates the intercept at which a trend line crosses the y-axis based on data series.

methods.name: LINEST
methods.description: Performs linear regression analysis and returns regression statistics or parameters.

methods.name: LOGEST
methods.description: Calculates an exponential regression curve fitting data series and returns regression statistics.

methods.name: RSQ
methods.description: Returns the square of the Pearson correlation coefficient, indicating goodness of fit.

methods.name: SLOPE
methods.description: Determines the slope of the linear regression line for data series.

methods.name: STEYX
methods.description: Calculates the standard error of the predicted y-value for each x in the regression.

methods.name: TREND
methods.description: Returns values along a linear trend line forecast.
